name: Standing Med Ball Chest Pass Throw
setup: Stand square or side-on a step from the wall, feet hip-width, ball at the chest.
cues: Step and snap the ball off the chest into the wall, as fast as you can.
Throw it as fast as you can into the wall.
The floor push starts the throw; the arms finish it.

faults.fix: Push the floor first, then let the turn and the arms follow.
Stop the set when the ball stops hitting the wall hard.
